categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in six business segments: carbon fiber production, general new materials (including various high-performance resin-based prepregs), energy new materials (notably pultruded carbon fiber composite profiles), composite materials technology (design and manufacturing of high-end composite parts), precision machinery (equipment manufacturing for carbon fiber and composites), and aerospace composite materials (design and production for aerospace applications). These segments cover the full carbon fiber industry chain from raw materials to finished composite products and related equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced carbon fiber production technologies including wet and dry-jet wet spinning processes for polyacrylonitrile (PAN)-based carbon fibers. It holds proprietary patents on fiber precursor preparation, carbon fiber production methods, and equipment. Manufacturing methods include pultrusion for carbon beams, automated fiber placement, winding, molding, and curing processes. The company also develops high-performance resin systems and automated composite manufacturing equipment, supporting integrated production from fiber to composite parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in aerospace, aviation, new energy (wind power, hydrogen energy, photovoltaics), defense, transportation (rail and automotive), industrial manufacturing, and sports leisure sectors. The company supplies carbon fibers and composites for high-end equipment such as large aircraft, rockets, wind turbine blades, hydrogen storage vessels, and unmanned aerial vehicles. It also serves emerging markets like low-altitude economy and 3C electronics with specialized prepregs and composite components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Weihai, Inner Mongolia (Baotou), and other locations. It has a subsidiary in Hong Kong for international trade. Domestic sales constitute about 78% of revenue, with overseas sales accounting for approximately 22%, reflecting growing export activities. The company’s products are used nationwide and increasingly in global markets, especially in aerospace and new energy sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company occupies an upstream to midstream position in the carbon fiber and composite materials supply chain. It produces raw carbon fibers, intermediate products like woven fabrics and prepregs, and downstream composite parts and structural components. Additionally, it manufactures key production equipment, enabling vertical integration and control over the entire carbon fiber composite production process.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-strength, high-modulus, and low-cost carbon fibers (T300, T700, T800, T1000 series), expanding high-performance resin systems, and advancing automated composite manufacturing technologies. R&D focuses on aerospace-grade materials, industrial applications, and emerging fields like energy storage flywheels and electric motor rotors. The company emphasizes innovation in fiber properties, composite design, and production efficiency to support national strategic industries and green energy development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of carbon fibers, prepregs, composite structural parts, and manufacturing equipment. The company operates on a product sales model with contracts for supply to aerospace, defense, energy, and industrial customers. It also earns income from technology licensing, government subsidies, and investment returns. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic carbon fiber manufacturer and a pioneer in China's carbon fiber industry, breaking foreign monopolies. It holds a dominant position in supplying carbon fiber to national defense and aerospace sectors and is expanding into civilian and industrial markets. Competitors include other domestic and international carbon fiber producers, but the company’s comprehensive product range, full industry chain integration, and strong R&D capabilities provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.45 billion, a slight decline of 2.69% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 741 million, down 15.12%. Despite market challenges, cash flow from operations increased by 61.46%. The company has steadily expanded production capacity, including a new 4,000-ton carbon fiber plant in Inner Mongolia. It maintains a solid asset base exceeding RMB 8 billion and continues investing in R&D and capacity expansion to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its full industry chain integration, enabling rapid innovation and quality control from raw fiber to finished composites. It offers a comprehensive and diversified product portfolio with proprietary technologies and national standards leadership. Its products meet stringent aerospace and defense requirements, with proven long-term reliability. The company’s advanced manufacturing equipment and stable technical team ensure high-quality, cost-effective solutions tailored to high-end and emerging market needs, supporting customers’ performance and sustainability goals.
